items.title: The token's Guard bar is taller, closer to the Health bar
items.do: Give Aveline Guard 4 (her sheet's Guard button), and look at her token's bars.
items.expect: The blue Guard bar above the Health bar reaches further down: about 2 pixels from the Health bar (the brass pin may touch it). The whole bar block keeps its height.

items.title: The sheet's bars: a click raises, a right-click lowers; the bar stays still
items.do: Open Aveline's sheet. Right-click her Vigor bar a few times, then left-click it; take her Vigor from 10 down to 9, and on to Bloodied (Ctrl+right-click: 5 at a time); do the same on Resolve until Strained.
items.expect: A right-click lowers the bar (1 damage), a left-click raises it (1 healed). The bar's track doesn't move or change width when the number loses a digit (10 to 9) or when the Bloodied / Strained tag appears.

items.title: The Token HUD's Vigor (red) and Resolve (blue) boxes
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token. In the red Vigor box at the bottom type -5 and Enter; then +2; in the blue Resolve box type 3 (a plain number).
items.expect: Two boxes at the bottom of the Token HUD in place of Foundry's one: Vigor (red) and Resolve (blue), each with its number left and "/ max". -5 deals 5 to Vigor only, +2 heals 2 of it, a plain number sets what is left of that pool (Resolve 3). The token's bars, Bloodied and Strained follow. Guard isn't used (a correction, like the sheet's bars).

items.title: The status palette in groups, with names
items.do: Right-click Orc Warrior's token and open its status effects (the conditions button). Click Prone's icon, then click the word Daunted; right-click an icon.
items.expect: The palette is in five groups (Health, Movement, Senses, Harmful, Helpful), each condition's icon with its name beside it; an active one is lit (bold name, a gold frame). A click on the icon or on the name toggles it as before; a right-click does what Foundry's right-click did.

items.title: A condition's number on the token and on the HUD's pills
items.do: On Aveline's turn, Demoralize Orc Warrior (GM Force Tier 2: Vulnerable 1); give it Slowed 2 from the palette. Look at its token, then select it and look at the HUD's conditions row.
items.expect: On the map, the Vulnerable and Slowed icons show their numbers (1, 2) in a white badge with a dark edge on the icon's corner. In the HUD, the pill's icon carries the number as a small badge, so it shows even when the name is cut short.

items.title: The Save dialog writes each Tier as the card does
items.do: Have Aveline (the level 4 build) use Word of Radiance on Orc Warrior, then click Orc Warrior's Save button on the card.
items.expect: The Save dialog's three Tiers read like the card ("[R] 3d6 Ho.", "No effect.", an effect's words), never the code ("3d6[mind,holy]").

items.title: A Large token can't end partly inside a wall
items.do: Drag Ogre Chieftain (2 x 2) beside a wall so that one column of its squares would end behind it (its center in the open); then, as the GM, Alt-drag it (Forced Movement) toward the wall.
items.expect: The drag is refused: "Ogre Chieftain doesn't fit there: part of its space would be inside a wall." A drag where the whole space fits works as before. The Alt-drag stops on the last space where it fits whole (the rest is a Collision).
